svg.title: A /metrics endpoint for Prometheus — SoftTrack web design mockup (#100)
svg.desc: GET /metrics serves Prometheus text: request counts and a duration histogram labelled by route template, plus counters for tickets, comments, digest sends and webhook deliveries. It needs METRICS_TOKEN as a bearer token and does not exist when the variable is unset.
svg.text: · request rates, latencies and a few domain counters, behind a token

g.text: # HELP softtrack_http_requests_total Requests handled, by route template.
# HELP softtrack_http_request_duration_seconds Time to respond, by route template.
# HELP softtrack_digest_sends_total Notification digests, by result.
# HELP softtrack_webhook_deliveries_total Webhooks, in and out.
series per route, not one per ticket.
Domain counters only where they are cheap:
tickets and comments created, digest sends,
same answer, compared in constant time
/metrics is left out of the request counters themselves, and out of the rate limiter’s buckets.

svg.text: prometheus-client plus a small ASGI middleware in backend/main.py, next to /health. Counters first: OpenTelemetry traces and ready-made dashboards stay out of scope.
Workers each hold their own counters, so a multi-worker deployment scrapes per process or uses prometheus-client’s multiprocess mode.
